    Lucien¶

    The fourth child. The quiet one. Named for light.

    Lucien is one of the two protagonists of Ge'or, born in 597 AGD in the Grimmel Republic. He is the fourth child of Herennia, an Erisian Empire mother, and Gallio, a Grimmel father. He has three older sisters — Sofia, Donna, and Oleana — who tease him mercilessly.

    His name means light. His mother chose it. She believed in brighter things.

    Before this life, he was a man named Arkady on dystopian Old Earth — Mikhail's closest friend. See: Emrys — Life Before Ge'or

    Early Life¶

    Lucien grows up quieter than Emrys — the kind of child who watches before speaking, who learned early that the fourth child's opinion is rarely asked for. His Erisian mother brought imperial refinement to a Grimmel household. His father brought Grimmel pragmatism. Lucien inherited both.

    He has three older sisters who tease him mercilessly. And one younger sister — Mana, born around 600 AGD — who understands him in a way no one else does. She was the AI in his head for three million years. Now she's the girl who sits next to him at dinner. Neither of them remembers. Yet.

    The Hope Goddess Mission¶

    Before birth, Lucien received the same vision as Emrys: the Hope Goddess, the war in the hope realm, the mission to destroy the hivemind in the Fortress Planet. He remembers none of it consciously. He is an infant. He cries. He sleeps. The weight of quintillions of dead souls rests on him, and he does not know.

    But like Emrys, Lucien has a previous life. He was Arkady — a man on dystopian Old Earth, Mikhail's closest friend, who fled into the wilderness with him, fought alongside him in the AGI ship raid, and was accidentally cryogenized in a Sterman Pod right beside him.

    Connections¶

    • Co-protagonist: Emrys (Mikhail in the previous life)
    • Previous life: Emrys — Life Before Ge'or — Arkady, rebel, Sterman Pod occupant
    • AI Companion: Mana — Arkady's AI, awake in his port for three million years. Now his little sister, born ~600 AGD.
    • Vision: Hope Goddess
    • Mission: Destroy the hivemind in Fortress Planet
    • The Claim: The Black Agent Hivemind can reach through his blood — discovered very late (see The Twinning)
    • Born: 597 AGD, Grimmel Republic
    • Mother: Herennia Mortvagn — Erisian Empire
    • Father: Gallio Mortvagn — Grimmel
    • Siblings: Sofia, Donna, Oleana — three older sisters
    • Power: Top 0.001% magical potential
    • Status: Child — the story begins
